items.title: AppBar Header
items.current: Large Playfair font dominates the bar
items.suggestion: Tone down the size of 'GOD' to ~24pt, increase 'WORD OF' to 14pt semi‑bold, add subtle gradient/glass‑morphism behind text

items.title: Book List Tiles
items.suggestion: Add hover/press ripple with accent color, prepend a small book icon, use soft elevation on press for tactile feel

items.title: Color Palette
items.suggestion: Introduce a secondary accent (warm gold/teal) for highlights, use alpha‑blended surfaces for glass effect

items.title: Typography Consistency
items.current: Playfair for body, Lexend for titles
items.suggestion: Reserve Playfair for verse content only, use Lexend (or similar sans‑serif) for all UI labels, define a global TextTheme in AppTheme

items.title: Responsive Layout
items.current: Fixed paddings (16px) may look sparse on tablets
items.suggestion: Switch to responsive spacing based on screen width, use Flex/Expanded for two‑column layout on home page

items.title: Dark‑Mode Polish
items.current: Deep green background, some low‑contrast text
items.suggestion: Verify WCAG AA contrast, use lighter surface for cards in dark mode

items.title: Bottom Navigation Bar
items.suggestion: Add persistent bottom bar with icons for Home, Search, Bookmarks, Settings

items.title: Search Experience
items.suggestion: Replace floating button expansion with full‑screen overlay, include cancel button and recent history

items.title: Book Detail Page
items.suggestion: Add sticky header with book name and back button that fades on scroll

items.title: Deep Linking
items.suggestion: Support URLs like myapp://book/Genesis to open directly to a book

items.title: Onboarding
items.suggestion: Create short onboarding flow explaining theme toggle, search, bookmarks, using premium glass cards and micro‑animations

items.title: Provider Consolidation
items.suggestion: Wrap all providers in a MultiProvider in main.dart; consider Riverpod or Bloc for future complexity

items.title: Localization
items.suggestion: Extract UI strings to ARB/JSON and use Intl for easy language addition

items.title: Theme Access
items.suggestion: Create a ThemeProvider exposing AppTheme styles via a custom ThemeExtension to reduce boilerplate

items.title: Async Loading
items.suggestion: Use FutureBuilder/StreamBuilder with skeleton loaders for premium feel

items.title: Testing
items.suggestion: Add unit tests for providers and widget tests for UI pages to catch regressions

items.title: Image Assets
items.suggestion: Prefer flutter_svg for vector icons to keep bundle size low

items.title: List Rendering
items.suggestion: Replace spread map with ListView.builder and itemExtent for smoother scrolling

items.title: Cache Bible Data
items.suggestion: Persist downloaded book list in shared_preferences or Hive for offline launch

items.title: Lazy Loading
items.suggestion: Load New Testament column only when it becomes visible (VisibilityDetector)

items.title: Code Splitting
items.suggestion: Enable deferred loading for heavy pages if targeting web

items.title: Semantic Labels
items.suggestion: Add semanticsLabel to icons and buttons

items.title: Dynamic Text Scaling
items.suggestion: Multiply fontSize by MediaQuery.textScaleFactor

items.title: Tap Targets
items.suggestion: Ensure interactive elements are at least 48×48 dp

items.title: Contrast Checker
items.suggestion: Run a contrast analyzer (e.g., flutter_lints) to meet WCAG

items.title: Screen‑Reader Navigation
items.suggestion: Provide meaningful tooltip/semanticLabel for theme toggle and navigation icons

items.title: Bookmark / Favorite Books
items.suggestion: Allow users to star books, store locally, and show a Favorites tab

items.title: Reading Progress
items.suggestion: Persist last opened chapter per book and display progress bar on home page

items.title: Audio Playback
items.suggestion: Integrate just_audio for verse audio playback

items.title: Sharing
items.suggestion: Add Share button on book page to copy deep link or verse text

items.title: Theming Customizer
items.suggestion: Small screen where users can pick a primary accent color via a color picker

items.title: Internationalization
items.suggestion: Add more languages (French, Arabic) using the same translation keys

items.title: README
items.suggestion: Add README with build instructions, architecture overview, design guidelines

items.title: Docs Folder
items.suggestion: Create docs/ with UI mockups (generated via generate_image) to version design decisions

items.title: Linting & Formatting
items.suggestion: Enable flutter_lints and run flutter format .

items.title: Separate UI from Logic
items.suggestion: Move book‑list tile widget to its own file (bible_book_tile.dart)

items.title: Comment Key Sections
items.suggestion: Add short comments above complex layout blocks (e.g., SliverAppBar gradient)
